tables.name: Population Wealth
tables.description: Modified by Stewardship, a Wealth/Possessions nobility and a Resources root of relationship with the people. Modifies General Crime.

results.name: Destitute
results.description: Nearly everyone in the capital consistently lacks the barest essentials of what they need to survive. (-2 to general crime roll)

results.name: Impoverished
results.description: Around half of the capital struggles to carve out even a meager existence. (-1 to general crime roll)

results.name: Average
results.description: Most of the capital’s population have enough to live a modest life. Those without are a minority. (+0 to general crime roll)

results.name: Prosperous
results.description: The majority have enough to live a good life and, of them, a fair amount can even live comfortably. (-1 to general crime roll)

results.name: Wealthy
results.description: Nearly everyone has what they need to live comfortably, many are able to live well, and some are very prosperous. (-2 to general crime roll)

results.name: Affluent
results.description: The entire capital is able to live comfortably, with a significant portion living in luxury. (-3 to general crime roll)
